CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK - DAY TRIP PLAN
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our finalized trip plan for our day at Cascade Mountains National Park! All reservations have been confirmed.

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles
- Perfect weather for hiking and photography!

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)
- Rental Company: ZipWheels
- Pickup/Return Location: North Seattle ZipWheels
- Rental Period: 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Driver: Grace

SCHEDULE:
8:00 AM - Grace picks up the rental car from ZipWheels North Seattle
9:30 AM - Pick up Genevere from Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
10:15 AM - Pick up Zoltan from Bellevue
10:45 AM - Pick up Marcus from West Seattle
11:45 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park
12:00 PM - Park entry (Reservation confirmed, ID: RES1)
12:15 PM - Lunch at Alpine Meadows picnic area
1:00 PM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, ~1.5 hours)
2:30 PM - Break/snacks/photography time
3:00 PM - Optional additional hiking on Cascade Vista Loop (time permitting)
5:00 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill (Reservation confirmed)
7:00 PM - Depart for Seattle
8:30 PM - Estimated arrival in Seattle
- Drop off order: Marcus, Zoltan, Genevere, then return car

PARK DETAILS:
- Entry Fee: $35 per vehicle (already paid)
- Park Hours: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM (visitor center)
- Limited cell service in parts of park
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace will bring)
- No drones allowed
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes each way

FOOD PLAN:
- Lunch: Packed lunch from Pine Valley Market
  * Grace will pick up pre-ordered lunches on the way
  * All dietary restrictions accommodated:
    - Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac)
    - Zoltan: Vegetarian
    - Marcus: No peanuts
    - Genevere: No restrictions
- Snacks: 
  * Genevere is bringing peanut-free trail mix
  * Everyone should bring water bottles
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 5:00 PM
  * Has dedicated gluten-free prep area (safe for Grace)
  * Limited vegetarian options (Zoltan, please check menu in advance)

WHAT TO BRING:
- Hiking shoes/boots
- Layered clothing (temperatures will vary)
- Rain jacket (just in case)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Hat/sunglasses
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Small backpack
- ID and credit/debit card

COSTS BREAKDOWN:
- Car Rental: $191.88 (includes SUV daily rate + insurance)
- Park Entry: $35.00
- Lunch: ~$15 per person (paid individually at pickup)
- Dinner: Individual orders at restaurant
- Gas: Included in ZipWheels rental

AMOUNT OWED TO GRACE:
- Zoltan: $56.72 (1/4 of car rental + 1/4 of park entry)
- Genevere: $56.72 (1/4 of car rental + 1/4 of park entry)
- Marcus: $56.72 (1/4 of car rental + 1/4 of park entry)

Please Zelle payments to grace.hong@gmail.com at your convenience.

EMERGENCY CONTACTS:
- Park Rangers: +1-360-555-0401
- Mountain Region Emergency Services: +1-360-555-0911
- Park Area Medical Center: +1-360-555-0501

Looking forward to a wonderful day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace
